questions.question: What is the average blood albumin level for female patients with a PLT greater than 400 who have been diagnosed with SLE?
questions.evidence: average blood albumin level refers to AVG(fld025); female refers to fld014 = 'F'; PLT greater than 400 refers to fld038 > 400; diagnosed with SLE refers to fld008= 'SLE'
questions.SQL: SELECT AVG(T2.fld025) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld038 > 400 AND T1.fld008 = 'SLE' AND T1.fld014 = 'F'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT AVG(T2.ALB) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.PLT > 400 AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T1.SEX = 'F'

questions.question: How many patients who were examined between 1987/7/6 and 1996/1/31 had a GPT level greater than 30 and an ALB level less than 4? List them by their ID.
questions.evidence: examined between 1987/7/6 and 1996/1/31 refers to fld019 BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'; GPT level greater than 30 refers to fld021 > 30; ALB level less than 4 fld025 < 4
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT fld001 FROM tab03 WHERE fld019 BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31' AND fld021 > 30 AND fld025 < 4
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31' AND GPT > 30 AND ALB < 4

questions.question: What is the disease patient '30609' diagnosed with. List all the date of laboratory tests done for this patient.
questions.evidence: '30609' is the Patient ID; disease means Diagnosis
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.fld008, T2.fld019 FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T1.fld001 = 30609
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.Diagnosis, T2.Date FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.ID = 30609

questions.question: State the ID and age of patient with positive degree of coagulation.
questions.evidence: age refers to SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(fld015)); positive degree of coagulation refers to fld010 = '+';
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.fld001, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.fld015) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab01 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld010 = '+'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RVVT = '+'

questions.question: Provide ID, sex and age of patient who has blood glucose (GLU) not within normal range but with total cholesterol(T-CHO) within normal range.
questions.evidence: age = SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(fld015)); blood glucose (fld033) not within normal range refers to fld033 > = 180; total cholesterol(T-CHO) within normal range refers to fld030 < 250;
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.fld001, T1.fld014, STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.fld015) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld033 >= 180 AND T2.fld030 < 250
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX , STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GLU >= 180 AND T2.`T-CHO` < 250

questions.question: For the patients with an abnormal Ig M level, what is the most common disease they are diagnosed with?
questions.evidence: abnormal Ig M level refers to fld048 <=40 OR fld048 >= 400; most common disease refers to MAX(COUNT(fld008));
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.fld008 FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE NOT T2.fld048 BETWEEN 40 AND 400 GROUP BY T1.fld008 ORDER BY COUNT(T1.fld008) DESC LIMIT 1
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGM NOT BETWEEN 40 AND 400 GROUP BY T1.Diagnosis ORDER BY COUNT(T1.Diagnosis) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Provide IDs for male patients with ALT glutamic pylvic transaminase (GPT) that have history of ALT glutamic pylvic transaminase (GPT) exceed the normal range.
questions.evidence: male refers to fld014 = 'M'; ALT glutamic pylvic transaminase (fld021) exceed the normal range refers to fld021 > = 60
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.fld001 FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T1.fld014 = 'M' AND T2.fld021 >= 60
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.GPT >= 60

questions.question: For the patients with a normal range of creatinine phosphokinase, how many of them have a positive measure of degree of coagulation?
questions.evidence: normal range of creatinine phosphokinase refers to fld032 < 250; positive measure of degree of coagulation refers to fld009 = '+' or fld010 = '+' or fld011 = '+' ;
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.fld001) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 INNER JOIN tab01 AS T3 ON T1.fld001 = T3.fld001 WHERE T2.fld032 < 250 AND (T3.fld009 = '+' OR T3.fld010 = '+' OR T3.fld011 = '+')
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.CPK < 250 AND (T3.KCT = '+' OR T3.RVVT = '+' OR T3.LAC = '+')

questions.question: How many patients with a abnormal C-reactive protein don't have their data recorded?
questions.evidence: abnormal C-reactive protein refers to fld049 ='+'; don't have data recorded refers to fld016 IS NULL;
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.fld001) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE (T2.fld049 = '+') AND T1.fld016 IS NULL
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE (T2.CRP = '+' ) AND T1.Description IS NULL

questions.question: Among the patients whose creatinine level is abnormal, how many of them aren't 70 yet?
questions.evidence: creatinine level is abnormal refers to fld028 >= 1.5; aren't 70 yet refers to SUBTRACT((YEAR(CURDATE()), YEAR(fld015))) < 70;
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.fld001) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld028 >= 1.5 AND STRFTIME('%Y', DATE('now')) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.fld015) < 70
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND STRFTIME('%Y', Date('now')) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) < 70

questions.question: What number of patients with a degree of thrombosis level 2 and ANA pattern of only S, have a level of anti-Cardiolip in antibody (IgM) 20% higher than average?
questions.evidence: thrombosis level 2 refers to fld013 = 2; ANA pattern of only S refers to fld005 = 'S'; average anti-Cardiolip in antibody (fld048) refers to AVG(fld004); calculation = MULTIPLY(AVG + AVG, 0.2)
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab01 WHERE fld013 = 2 AND fld006 = 'S' AND fld004 > (SELECT AVG(fld004) * 1.2 FROM tab01 WHERE fld013 = 2 AND fld006 = 'S')
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Examination WHERE Thrombosis = 2 AND `ANA Pattern` = 'S' AND `aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 1.2 FROM Examination WHERE Thrombosis = 2 AND `ANA Pattern` = 'S')

questions.question: For patient born between 1936-1956, how many male patients have creatinine phosphokinase beyond the normal range?
questions.evidence: born between 1936-1956 refers to year(fld015) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956'; male patients refers to fld014 = 'M'; creatinine phosphokinase beyond the normal range refers to fld032 > = 250; Should consider DISTINCT in the final result;
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.fld001) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.fld015) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956' AND T1.fld014 = 'M' AND T2.fld032 >= 250
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956' AND T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.CPK >= 250

questions.question: Provide all ID, sex and birthday of patients whose urea nitrogen (UN) just within the borderline of passing?
questions.evidence: urea nitrogen (fld027) just within the borderline of passing refers to fld027 = 29;
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.fld001, T1.fld014, T1.fld015 FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld027 = 29
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.UN = 29

questions.question: Are there more in-patient or outpatient who were male? What is the deviation in percentage?
questions.evidence: male refers to fld014 = 'M'; in-patient refers to fld018 = '+'; outpatient refers to fld018 = '-'; percentage = DIVIDE(COUNT(fld001) where fld014 = 'M' and fld018 = '+', COUNT(fld001) where fld014  = 'M' and fld018 = '-')
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fld018 = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN fld018 = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM tab02 WHERE fld014 = 'M'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M'

questions.question: Among the patients who has a normal level of anti-centromere and a normal level of anti-SSB, how many of them are male?
questions.evidence: normal level of anti-centromere refers to fld059 IN('-', '+-'); normal level of anti-SSB refers to fld058 IN('-', '+-'); male refers to fld014 = 'M'; Should consider DISTINCT in the final result;
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.fld001) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld059 IN ('negative', '0') AND T2.fld058 IN ('negative', '0') AND T1.fld014 = 'M'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CENTROMEA IN ('negative', '0') AND T2.SSB IN ('negative', '0') AND T1.SEX = 'M'

questions.question: Among the patients with a normal Ig G level, how many of them have symptoms?
questions.evidence: normal Ig G level refers to fld046 > 900 and fld046 < 2000; have symptoms refers to fld012 IS NOT NULL;
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.fld001) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 INNER JOIN tab01 AS T3 ON T3.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld046 BETWEEN 900 AND 2000 AND NOT T3.fld012 IS NULL
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T3.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGG BETWEEN 900 AND 2000 AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL

questions.question: Among the patients who has a normal anti-scl70, how many of them are female and does not have any symptom?
questions.evidence: normal anti-scl70 refers to fld056 IN('negative', '0'); female refers to fld014 = 'F'; does not have any symptom refers to fld012 IS NULL; Should consider DISTINCT in the final result;
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.fld001) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 INNER JOIN tab01 AS T3 ON T3.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE (T2.fld056 = 'negative' OR T2.fld056 = '0') AND T1.fld014 = 'F' AND T3.fld012 IS NULL
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T3.ID = T2.ID WHERE (T2.SC170 = 'negative' OR T2.SC170 = '0') AND T1.SEX = 'F' AND T3.Symptoms IS NULL

questions.question: What is the average age of the male patient with high cholesterol?
questions.evidence: average age = DIVIDE(SUM(SUBTRACT(YEAR(NOW()), YEAR(fld015))), COUNT(fld001)); male patient refers to fld014 = 'M'; high cholesterol refers to fld030 > = 250;
questions.SQL: SELECT AVG(STRFTIME('%Y', DATE('NOW')) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.fld015)) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld030 >= 250 AND T1.fld014 = 'M'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT AVG(STRFTIME('%Y', date('NOW')) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`T-CHO` >= 250 AND T1.SEX = 'M'

questions.question: What is the ratio of outpatient to inpatient followed up treatment among all the 'SLE' diagnosed patient?
questions.evidence: 'SLE' diagnosed patient means fld008 = 'SLE'; inpatient refers to fld018 = '+'; outpatient refers to fld018 = '-'; calculation =  DIVIDE(COUNT(fld001) where fld008 = 'SLE' and fld018 = '+', COUNT(fld001) where fld008 = 'SLE' and fld018 = '-')
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN fld018 = '+' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN fld018 = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM tab02 WHERE fld008 = 'SLE'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'

questions.question: How old was the patient who had the highest hemoglobin count at the time of the examination, and what is the doctor's diagnosis?
questions.evidence: How old the patient refers to SUBTRACT(year(fld002), year(fld015)); the highest hemoglobin count refers to MAX(fld036)
questions.SQL: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', T2.fld019) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.fld015), T1.fld008 FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 ORDER BY T2.fld036 DESC LIMIT 1
questions.SQL_original: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday), T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID ORDER BY T2.HGB DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Among the patients who have an abnormal level of glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase, when was the youngest of them born?
questions.evidence: abnormal level of glutamic oxaloacetic transaminase refers to fld020 > = 60; The larger the birthday value, the younger the person is, and vice versa;
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.fld015 FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld020 >= 60 ORDER BY T1.fld015 DESC LIMIT 1
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GOT >= 60 ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: For patients with abnormal platelet level, state the number of patients with lower than normal range. How is it compare to the number of patients with higher than normal range?
questions.evidence: abnormal platelet level refers to fld038 <= 100 or fld038 >= 400; platelet level lower than normal range refers to fld038 < 100; calculation = SUBTRACT(SUM(fld038 < 100), SUM(fld038 > 400)); platelet level higher than normal range refers to fld038 > 400;
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.fld038 <= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.fld038 >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001
questions.SQL_original: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.PLT <= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.PLT >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

questions.question: List and group all patients by sex for total bilirubin (T-BIL) level not within the normal range.
questions.evidence: List refers to GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT fld001); total bilirubin (T-BIL) not within normal range refers to T-BIL > = 2.0
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.fld001, T1.fld014 FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld029 >= 2.0 GROUP BY T1.fld014, T1.fld001
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.ID,T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 GROUP BY T1.SEX,T1.ID

questions.question: How many patients with an Ig G higher than normal?
questions.evidence: Ig G higher than normal refers to fld046 >= 2000; Should consider DISTINCT in the final result;
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.fld001) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 INNER JOIN tab01 AS T3 ON T3.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld046 >= 2000
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T3.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGG >= 2000

questions.question: For laboratory examinations take in 1984, list all patients below 50 years old with normal platelet level.
questions.evidence: laboratory examinations take in 1984 refers to YEAR(fld019) = '1984'; below 50 years old = SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(fld015)) < 50; normal platelet level refers to fld038 between 100 and 400;
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.fld001 FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld038 BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.fld019) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.fld015) < 50 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.fld019) = '1984'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) < 50 AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) = '1984'
